thought.text: I found the issue — the first form has `Step=LocalLogin`, but the login form has `Step=Login`. I'll retry with the correct value.

reasoning_content: I see the form is posting to index.pl with the Step parameter set to "Login" rather than "LocalLogin" — my grep was picking up the first match from the language selector form instead of the actual login form. Let me resubmit with the correct Step value.

action.command: cd /tmp && curl -s -b qcookie.txt -c qcookie.txt http://localhost/qisutu/index.pl -o qisutu-index.html && CSRF=$(grep -oE 'name="CSRFToken" value="[^"]*"' qisutu-index.html | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//') && curl -s -b qcookie.txt -c qcookie.txt -D login-headers.txt -o login-after.html -X POST http://localhost/qisutu/index.pl --data-urlencode "CSRFToken=$CSRF" --data-urlencode "Step=Login" --data-urlencode "AccountType=agent" --data-urlencode "Language=en" --data-urlencode "Login=admin" --data-urlencode "Password=LVRS3SUBEBF+SJQBDF_%4FYY" && cat login-headers.txt | head -8; echo '---'; grep -oE '<title>[^<]*</title>' login-after.html | head -2
